query:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(s.saleDate, '%Y-%m') as competenceMonth,
  s.saleType,
  COUNT(*) as qtd,
  SUM(s.subtotal) as totalVendas
FROM sales s
WHERE s.status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(s.saleDate, '%Y-%m'), s.saleType
ORDER BY competenceMonth DESC, s.saleType
LIMIT 20;
